newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: High dollar keeps European feeds trade calm.
newsitem.headline: High dollar keeps European feeds trade calm.

text.p: The highest dollar versus major European currencies since July 1994 kept business on the European meals and feeds market restricted to a couple of trades, mostly for nearby positions, market sources said.
"The dollar reached a top of 1.6001 today which discouraged many operators from entering the market," one broker said.
Afloat Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $304 a tonne cif Amsterdam and spot Argentine soymeal pellets changed hands at $160 a tonne fob Rotterdam.
